text:
mina: Support -> CS escalation: Aurora Labs trial ingest failing for nightly seed. Support reports mixed 429s and occasional 504s during big CSV import. AE marked renewal at-risk because they demo in 20h. Need quick mitigation + short customer comm.

cole: Can someone paste recent proxy logs? Want to confirm whether this is rate-limit vs model-runner degradation. :mag_right:

yasmin: Paste: `2025-03-11T22:05:12Z WARN rate_limiter tenant=aurora qps=920 limit=600` then `2025-03-11T22:05:38Z ERROR proxy upstream read timeout model-runner-9`. No auth errors. Looks like burst > tenant qps followed by runner latency.

yasmin: Ops options: (1) temporary tenant QPS bump for the seed window, (2) enable regional routing to a less-loaded region (if tenant allowed), (3) ask customer to split CSV into smaller files and reduce concurrency/batch size, (4) enable request-level sampling to let heavy requests be retried at lower concurrency. Command to bump qps: `infra tenant update-qps aurora --qps 1600 --note "trial seed bump"`

mina: Prefer not to change model route to keep embeddings stable for the demo. Regional routing is interesting if latency allows. Cole, can you confirm if Aurora is allowed multi-region? If yes, prefer routing traffic to eu-west-2 where capacity is available.

cole: Checking tenant config now. Aurora has multi-region enabled. Quick plan: (A) apply a short QPS bump for the next 2 hours and add a regional route for the ingest window (owner: cole/ops), (B) ask Aurora to split CSV into chunks of ~10k rows and run at 3 concurrent workers with batch_size=12 (owner: mina/CS), (C) AE to mark renewal-risk and prepare demo backup plan (owner: yasmin/AE).

yasmin: Draft CS note (send in 8m): "Hi Aurora team  we're seeing throttling on large imports. For the upcoming seed, could you split the file into 10k chunks and run with 3 workers / batch_size=12? We'll apply a temporary capacity bump and route ingest traffic to an alternate region while we monitor. We'll update in 20 minutes and aim for full stability within 3 hours. Apologies for the disruption — we'll follow up with a post-demo recap." Thoughts?

mina: Works. Add explicit line: "This bump and regional route will not change your embeddings (unless we switch model)." Keep ETA: confirm in 20m and target resolution in 3h.

cole: Infra actions: applying qps bump and adding regional route now. infra-bot: TASK-20451 created for aurora qps+route. Route change at 2739123520.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-20250311-77 opened by cole  priority=P1  aurora ingest throttling. PagerDuty notified. https://redwood.incidents/INC-20250311-77

yasmin: Sent CS note at 2739123530. Customer replied: "We'll split the file and throttle workers. Will the alternate region affect latency for our demo?"

mina: Reply to customer: "Alternate region is only for the ingest window; demo endpoints will remain in your primary region. No changes to model weights." Sent.

cole: Monitoring update @2739123656: error spikes reduced ~90%, occasional 429s at peak but within acceptable range. Regional route absorbing most ingest traffic; CPU on model-runner-9 trending down. Keeping monitors for 4 hours.

mina: Great. AE notified and renewal-risk flagged. Action items: (1) ops monitor & remove regional route after stabilization (cole), (2) CS follow-up recap post-demo with best-practices for large seeds (mina), (3) infra/PM evaluate pre-warm and chunking guidance (yasmin).

mina: Postmortem please include timeline, customer impact, mitigation, and suggested long-term fixes: pre-warm window for large seeds, regional capacity hints in onboarding docs, and an automated ingest-splitter suggestion in SDK. Closing CS handoff for now — reopen if errors recur. :white_check_mark:
